name: Philadelphia Music Studios - Cotton St. Music

reviews.text: Mike is a treasure for local musicians.  His studios are great.  Good equipment and he keeps them clean and well ventilated and cool in the summer.  Mike is super easy to work with.  He’s also a really good guitar teacher for all levels.  And he’s got a nice repair shop.
reviews.author: Ed Rogers

reviews.text: Great rehearsal space, convenient to parking (and good unload/load access), good acoustics, and extremely helpful staff for tech/logistical/comfort help. Already kicking myself for risking making it harder to book the space!
reviews.author: Brian Kearney

reviews.text: Fantastic location for rehearsing with groups. Mike provided a space that was great for filming a few YouTube videos. We parked a block or two north of the rehearsal space after load-in. Will be back again soon!
reviews.author: Tinuke Oyefule

reviews.text: Great place to massage your muse. Mike has it all. Pure sweetness
reviews.author: harryhones

reviews.text: Mike and co are the best! This is my go-to rehearsal space and I also use them for my guitar setups.
reviews.author: Tyler Sensenig
